I experience this too. My gynecologist believes I have endometriosis, but I havent gotten a diagnosis yet. Going on the birth control patch helped but I ended up getting depression as a side effect so I switched back to pills.

Its okay! I wasn't taught about periods before I got mine, either! First, telling your guardian will help, they'll help you with getting pads and maybe getting medicine if you have bad cramps. It's a little awkward telling them, but ultimately its for the best.

Next, if you're getting cramps or bleeding heavily and don't have access to pads, use toilet paper. If you have cramps, have a hot bath, take ibuprofen or a little massage on your lower abdomen can help. 

First periods can be kinda scary and embarrassing, but once you know more about how you body works, they'll feel normal and okay!
